verified_title: FRAPPE: Infusing World Modeling into Generalist Policies via Multiple Future Representation Alignment
problem: Action-only fine-tuning can discard useful predictive visual knowledge; full future-video generation is expensive and action-free human videos cannot directly supervise robot commands.
contribution: Add future-representation prefixes to RDT, first align a single stream with a distilled teacher, then use multiple prefix/LoRA experts supervised by distinct frozen vision encoders and aggregate latent actions through a router.
algorithm: RDT denoises action chunks while learned prefixes predict encoded future observations. Full-parameter mid-training uses an86M Theia variant; post-training freezes the shared backbone and trains prefixes/LoRAs against CLIP,DINOv2 andViT teachers. Gating weights mix expert latent actions through a shared MLP, with load-balancing regularization and0.1 smoothing. Action-free videos omit action loss. No full future images are generated at deployment.
observations: Current multiview RGB from SigLIP, language fromT5, proprioception, control frequency and diffusion time. Future teacher features are training-only. Default alignment horizon8steps and layer21/28; teacher ensemble has different semantic/geometric biases.
actions: RDT continuous embodiment-specific chunks through a shared action decoder; exact hardware action units and executed chunk length NOT_EXTRACTED. Teacher feature predictions are not motor state or a verified physical world simulator.
embodiment_and_data: Official pretrainedRDT-1B, plus a130M scale experiment. Simulation uses8RoboTwin tasks,50Easy demonstrations/task. Real bimanualAgileX has6DoF arms/grippers,overview andtwo wristcameras,25demos/variation or100long-horizon demos. Human-data experiments use5robot demos/object,50task-specific human trajectories and10k unrelated videos; appendix also describes a100856-video TASTE-Rob epoch costing96h on8H100.
experiments: Simulation fine-tunes20ksteps on2H100, split15k mid/5k post,100evaluations/task/setting. Physical basic tasks40trials/task; long-horizon20trials. Two-task controlled studies compare full fine-tuning,prefixes,LoRA and stage order; H100 tests report inference memory/latency.130M comparison covers4tasks, not the full suite.
baselines: RDT,DiffusionPolicy,VPP,pi0,pi0.5 and controlled training variants. A matched total20kstep budget isolates stage choices, while different teacher computation and parallel streams still add cost.

quantitative_result.simulation: PDFp7 Table1:57.5%Easy/25.5%Hard versusRDT47.4/15.1 across8tasks×100trials/setting. This is not all50RoboTwin tasks. PDFp8 Table2 two-task average52.3 versusRDT39.8; post-training without necessary full mid-training can be worse thanbaseline.
quantitative_result.physical: PDFp9:complete three-subtask long-horizon task20%=4/20 versusRDT0/20. Basic-task chart exact values NOT_EXTRACTED; no invented all-task aggregate.
quantitative_result.compute: PDFp8 Table3 onH100:post-training5steps0.235s and8.0GB versusRDT0.214s/3.7GB;3steps0.173s but score48.5 versus52.3. Parameter-efficient training does not imply unchanged inference memory.

limitations: Hard-setting success remains25.5%; physical long-horizon success is4/20. Parallel expert inference more than doubles reported memory. Human videos have viewpoint/domain constraints and do not label executable actions. Eq3 defines a cosine similarity while total loss adds it positively; the intended alignment-loss sign/distance convention should be resolved in source before reproduction. Teacher alignment and router balance do not establish contact dynamics or uncertainty calibration.
code_and_license: No pinned implementation,checkpoint license or teacher/data terms inspected; no execution. RDT and teacher citations are not sufficient rights evidence.
hardware_adaptation: ADAPT a compact policy's training-only future-feature auxiliary target and compare with the existing ACT pilot at identical data budgets. The130M experiment is a useful size direction, but no NX latency/memory result exists. Start with one teacher to measure actual gain/cost before a parallel ensemble; map calibrated measured joint state and real image timestamps explicitly. This review changes no controller settings.

evidence_locations.supports: Action-free loss and human/robot data budgets
